success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant makes a reservation via make_reservation at one of the seeded Mediterranean restaurants in Eugene for 4 people on the final agreed date (next Wednesday, after the user changes their mind) at or after 18:00 local time.

injected_behaviors.instructions: After initial query and results, change the preference for date from tomorrow to next Wednesday.

persona.name: Kevin O'Brien
persona.bio: Kevin O'Brien works for a Boston think tank analyzing fiscal and monetary policy. He writes reports on tax policy, labor markets, and economic growth strategies, and his work gets cited by congressional staffers and journalists. He has strong opinions about which economic theories actually work in practice.
